help.howTo: One change is one edit. Set updated to now on every write, even when nothing else changed. Counts on the page are worked out from candidates, so never store them. Times are ISO with the IST offset, for example 2026-11-27T12:00:00+05:30. Keep pay figures, employer names, emails and phone numbers off this file: it is public. No cost or spend figures either: describe numbers in words.
help.stage: shortlisted (not contacted yet), contacted (invite or first message sent, no reply), replied, proof (ad account screenshots received), call (call booked)
help.outcome: null while in play; dropped or declined when someone leaves this round (keep stage at the furthest step they reached)
help.proof: typed: yes or no. numbers: yes, partial or no. screenshots: no, asked, refused or yes
help.callConditional: On a candidate at stage call: true while the call is held on a condition (callCondition says which, for example needs screen share); it then counts as conditional, not confirmed. Set false or remove it once the condition is met
help.decisions: Only open decisions for Bhaskar. Each: id, candidate (a candidate id), title, detail, since. Empty list shows decisionsEmpty
help.closed: true for earlier rounds and closed contacts: shown collapsed at the bottom and left out of every count
